name: 1.108.3 (LTS)
body:
> [!TIP]
> The `lts` image tag always points to the latest LTS release. Pull `ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:lts` to stay on the newest LTS patch

## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.108.3
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.108.3 (LTS)

11 PRs. 3 fixed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **AWS Bedrock:** Fixed every request failing on a Bedrock deployment with `api_base: ""`, which answered 500 or 400 (#50449)
- **MCP:** Fixed tool results over 1 MiB failing with `SSE stream ended without a response`, broken since v1.103.0 (#47034)
- **Guardrails:** Fixed model-level `post_call` guardrails checking each response twice and calling the moderation provider twice (#50463)

---

Backport #50484 · Backport #50487 · [Full changelog](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/compare/v1.108.2...v1.108.3)
